title: Create KLineChart React wrapper component
description: Create a React wrapper component for the klinecharts library. This is a low-level wrapper that manages chart initialization, data updates, indicator overlays, and cleanup. klinecharts is framework-agnostic so we need proper React lifecycle management with useRef/useEffect.

files.change: Create React wrapper for klinecharts with init, dispose, applyNewData, createIndicator lifecycle management
Create barrel export for stock-chart components

implementation: Create apps/dsa-web/src/components/stock-chart/KLineChart.tsx using useRef to hold Chart instance, useEffect for init on mount and dispose on unmount
Define KLineChartProps: data (StockChartKlineItem[]), indicators (array of indicator names like 'MACD', 'KDJ', 'BOLL', 'VOL'), height (number), className (string)

Use klinecharts `init(dom)` to create chart, `applyNewData(data)` to load K-line data, `createIndicator(name, false, {id: 'candle_pane'})` for overlay indicators and `createIndicator(name, false)` for sub-chart indicators
Map data from StockChartKlineItem to klinecharts format: { timestamp: new Date(date).getTime(), open, high, low, close, volume }
Handle indicator lifecycle: when indicators prop changes, remove old indicators via `removeIndicator` and create new ones. MACD/KDJ/VOL go to sub-panes, BOLL overlays on main candle pane

reference.pattern: React wrapper for imperative library pattern (useRef + useEffect lifecycle)
reference.examples: klinecharts API: init(container), dispose(), applyNewData(data), createIndicator(name, isStack, paneOptions), removeIndicator(paneId, name)

criteria: KLineChart component accepts data, indicators, height, className props
Chart initializes on mount and disposes on unmount with no memory leaks
Data mapped from StockChartKlineItem to klinecharts {timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume} format
MACD, KDJ, VOL display as sub-chart panes; BOLL overlays on main candle pane
Component re-renders correctly when data or indicators props change
